main.description: How to have a space indexed by this appview. No authentication.

did.description: The service DID requests are addressed to.

grantUrl.description: Where a space's authority lets the appview read the space, so it indexes it. Open it in a browser with ?space=<space URI>&mode=grant (or mode=stop to take that back) and optionally return=<URL to come back to>, on an origin the appview allows.

registration.description: open: any space's authority can have it indexed at grantUrl. closed: only the spaces the operator chooses.
